purpose: check that the product works on the phones and tablets users own, across sizes, operating systems, hardware and conditions
entry_criteria: A mobile app or responsive web build exists
Real devices or a device farm are accessible
inputs: device and operating system usage data
procedure: Select the device set from usage data: popular models, oldest supported OS, smallest and largest screens, low-memory devices.
Run the core journeys on each device, including rotation, text size changes, and dark mode.
Test hardware dependent features such as camera, location, biometrics, notifications and sensors with permission granted and denied.
Test interruptions and conditions: incoming calls, low battery, low storage, background and resume, and poor or lost connectivity.
Record issues with device, OS version, steps and a recording, and group them by cause.
Update the device set each quarter from fresh usage data.
acceptance_criteria: Permission denied and interruption cases were tested
Issues carry device and OS details
The device set has a review date

validation.check: run checkout on the oldest supported OS and the smallest screen
validation.expect: task completes and nothing is cut off

validation.check: deny camera permission and open the scan feature

failure_modes.response: Add oldest supported OS and low memory

failure_modes.mode: Text clipped at large font size

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Usage data selects eight devices. A low-memory phone restarts the app during photo upload, and a denied location permission produces a blank map; both are logged with device and OS version.
